title: Viyabari
desc: A zealous entrepreneur clones himself to balance his work and family life. However, after a tragic mishap, he realizes the unforeseen consequences of his actions.

title: Jay Jay
desc: Jagan and Jamuna spend all day chatting on their first meeting. Jamuna puts down her details on a 100-rupee note declaring that if the note comes back to Jagan, then they are destined to meet.

title: Kabali
desc: When Kabali raises his voice against the oppression faced by Tamil labourers in Malaysia, he is imprisoned for 25 years. After being released, he seeks revenge on the ones who wronged him.

title: LKG
desc: LKG, a councillor of a small town, aspires to become the chief minister of the state. He enlists the help of the corporates to impress the public but faces threat from another politician.

title: Devathayai Kandaein
desc: A tea seller deeply in love faces heartbreak when the woman he adores chooses a wealthier match, pushing him to seek justice in a unique and emotional way.
